h: 我已经厌倦了人们将节点堆叠得如此密集，以至于你无法阅读它或观察生成过程中发生的情况。这展示了工作流程的有机性，以便您可以真正遵循它。是的，它是意大利面条，但它美味又营养。如果您拥有 GPU 资源和正确的模型，它几乎可以很好地生成任何内容。我希望这对某人有帮助！

o.en: I'm over people stacking nodes so densely you can't read it or watch what's happening during the generation. This one shows how organic a workflow is so you can actually follow it. Yes it's spaghetti, but it's delicious and nutritious. It will generate just about anything reasonably well if you have the GPU resources and the right model. I hope this helps someone!
